summary: refactor(shared): move email DNS validation to @fxa/shared/email/server
description:
Because:

* The email DNS validation code uses Node dns and lived in fxa-shared.
* It must sit behind a server-only entry of the @fxa/shared/email lib.

This commit:

* Moves validateEmail and emailValidatorErrors to libs/shared/email.
* Adds the @fxa/shared/email/server entry, path alias and jest mapping.
* Points account.ts at the new entry and leaves fxa-shared shims.
* Mocks DNS in the account.spec.ts domain tests and adds lib and shim specs.

Closes FXA-14698
